strengths: Correctly identifies the dominant CD34+GATA2+HOXA9+ HSPC program using CD34, GATA2, HOXA9, CRHBP, EGFL7, LYL1, HHEX.
Correctly treats FCER1A/LYZ/IL1B as lineage priming rather than a mature DC/monocyte assignment.
weaknesses: Composite stem/progenitor label cannot map to a single CL term.
Proposed HSC CL:0000037 lacks decisive HSC-versus-progenitor branch evidence from the original markers.

strengths: Exact, clean ontology mapping to CL:0008001.
Broad hematopoietic precursor label captures the dominant CD34+ HSPC identity without over-committing to an unsupported HSC or early-myeloid branch.
Consistent with absence of mature lymphoid, monocyte, and dendritic cell markers.
weaknesses: Less specific than possible descendant terms; lineage priming is reflected only in secondary signals.

clusterProfiler.predicted_cell_type: Hematopoietic Stem/Progenitor Cell (HSPC) / Early Myeloid Progenitor
strengths: Correctly recognizes the HSPC program and notes the absence of mature lineage markers.
Acknowledges low-level FCER1A/LYZ/IL1B signals as lineage priming rather than committed identity.
weaknesses: 'Early Myeloid Progenitor' is not directly supported because the primitive CD34/GATA2/HOXA9/CRHBP/EGFL7 signature is dominant.
Candidate mappings to CL:0002031/CL:0002032 are ambiguous and lack direct lineage-restricted/oligopotent support.

supporting: CD34, GATA2, HOXA9, CRHBP, EGFL7, LYL1, HHEX, SPINK2, PRSS57 support a CD34+ hematopoietic precursor/HSPC identity.
PMID 37407551 provides allowed literature support for the HSPC interpretation of this marker program.
conflicting: FCER1A, LYZ, IL1B, AIF1, LST1 are potential myeloid/DC/monocyte signals but are outweighed by the primitive CD34+ HSPC program and interpreted as lineage priming.
NFE2 and MPP1 indicate weak erythroid/megakaryocytic priming but are insufficient to call megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor identity.
No mature lineage markers such as CD3, CD19, CD14, or CD56 are present.
enrichment_or_literature: Retrieved literature PMID 37407551 supports the CD34+ HSPC annotation.
PMID 34135910 was also retrieved and is consistent with primitive hematopoietic progenitor programs.
